answer.explanation: ShipmentController (presentation) imports and is constructor-injected with ShipmentRepository (persistence), skipping the business layer. It calls repo.markReturned directly in registerReturn, so a state change happens in the controller without going through ShipmentService. FF-S03 flags presentation reaching persistence without passing through the layer between them. The material provided has no docs, ADRs or comments declaring a layering rule or an exception for this case.
